text: Careful with that relay... You're the only one left in the shielded zone who can still do something about this. Power up the lab before the pocket collapses.

when: Looking at the dark power wall (proposal)
text: [breathes] Follow the cables. Capacitors, breaker, relays. Power runs left to right, same as reading.
Good. Now the relays. One at a time... they're older than both of us.
Power's holding... Barely. Look out the observation window.

when: Looking out at the void storm
text: Look outside. That storm? That's what happens when reality runs out of compute. A simulation can't sustain simulations running inside of it... We fed too much power to our digital creations, and now our creations are no longer bound to their simulated chains.
The good news is you figured out a way to fix it. This lab is shielded, and using the bridge technology we punched a portal straight to the moon. Pull the lever and let's see if the link holds.
[pause] Coils are warming... bottom up, like they should. Don't stand in the frame until it settles.
[relieved] It's holding. That's the Moon on the other side. Well. What's left of it.
Stage 0. Black and white, 1-bit Bayer dither, barely holding together. In these conditions your sync will drain fast. Get that first Shape Press down and start feeding the resolution loop.
Your sync's dropping. Head back through the gate before it bottoms out.
Lattice stabilized! Resolution is bumping up to Stage 1. Now come back into the lab and grab the extraction tool from the armory rack.
You need a tool cartridge to use it for anything other than mining. Step outside, mine 50 units of dirt, and bring it back to build the Dirt-to-Ore processor.
It's not really dirt, you get that right? We're just calling it that for your sake—we can change it at any time we want.

Open up the studio terminal. See those variables? That's the simulation schema. If you change a name or tweak a setting, you can submit it to the weekly consensus queue. Out there, it's majority rules. If you walk into a sector where others have a different sync, you can merge with them or branch off into a solo desynced expedition.
The Light Amplifier is online. Look at that crater—the wave is spreading! Color is returning. If we push this all the way to Stage 4, reality stabilizes for good.
Foundations first. Everything you build out there leans on something. Make it lean on that.
That won't hold. Give it something to stand on.
[pause] ...Yeah. Gravity's still running at full resolution.

when: First beam harvest of raw pixels
text: Raw pixels. Feed them to a mill and they'll come out as textures you can build with.
That bin's on the bridge. Anything you put in it, every bench on your base can reach. Don't ask me how; I built it and I'm still not sure.

when: Drafting table, first primitive and map combined
text: Shape and finish. That's a blueprint. You're basically writing reality now. Neatly, I hope.
Seal holding, life support green. You've got air in there. Breathe while you can.
A vehicle fabricator. The scout opens once this plot hits stage two. Keep the wave moving.
[dry] It's small, it's loud, and it's yours. Try not to roll it.
Same frame, new part. The bench makes them; you can swap them anywhere.
Hauler's printable. Its bin rides on the bridge too, so your storage goes where you drive.
Stage six. The crawler's yours. That drill on the front isn't for decoration.
That's... a sprite. A real one. They broke loose when the simulation cracked. Keep your distance.
It came apart in pixels. Whatever they are, they're not alive the way we are.
[quietly] You're hurt. Back off and patch up.
Stage two. Sixteen colours. Never thought I'd be happy to see EGA again.
Two hundred and fifty-six colours. It's starting to look like somewhere.
Smooth shading. The light's bending right again. Reality's stabilising here.
Almost there. Can you hear that? Neither can I. The noise is going.
[breathes] Full resolution. That's how the Moon is supposed to look. One plot down.
You're on the shared grid now. What the majority builds, everyone sees.
Solo branch. Your Moon, your rules. Nobody else's changes reach you here.

when: Sealing the Act IV dormant leak: the first Anomaly Core (Argo)
text: Clean seal. That core's condensed archive data—bring it inside, the Combiner can splice it.

when: 20 s before a leak opens its waves (Argo)
text: Archive pressure's spiking—twenty seconds before a perimeter rift tears open. Ready your weapon.
